change: Shared Slack admission and durable proof for locally deferred sends
verified_behaviors: Workspace-method cooldown applies across member and bot tokens and channels.
Different workspace or method is independent; posts also retain a one-second channel deadline.
HTTP 429 and Slack JSON ratelimited responses preserve Retry-After; absent deadlines default to 30 seconds.
Failure to acquire a second lane releases the first lock.
A fenced locally rejected send restores unentered status atomically with send_deferred evidence.
Gmail and both Slack actors retry after local cooldown without duplicate sends.
A changed reply during cooldown supersedes the old action before sending.
Lost responses, Slack internal errors and malformed success remain uncertain.
Source and send delays update the shared task summary without closing the todo.
limits: Slack admission and retry evidence use local PostgreSQL leases and mock providers, not live Slack.
Native clients consume the existing shared summary field; native builds and visual checks were not repeated for this server-only change.
The queued October memory eval remains scheduled for September 16 at 08:00 Eastern; no duplicate was started.
Slack pagination, whole-app recovery and the real longevity canary remain unfinished.
